**Static class** in the `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Ipp](/docs/reference/#latiprimereipp) package.

```csharp
public static class LatiprimereIppServiceCollectionExtensions
```

Registers the IPP network print system with a dependency injection container.

## Methods

### AddLatiprimereIpp

```csharp
public static IServiceCollection AddLatiprimereIpp(this IServiceCollection services, Action<IppNetworkOptions>? configure = null)
```

Registers direct printing to IPP network printers. Use together with `AddLatiprimere()` from the Latiprimere package, and `AddLatiprimerePdfium()` from Latiprimere.Rendering.Pdfium to print PDFs as raster to printers that can't take PDF.

**Parameters**

- `services`: The service collection to add to.
- `configure`: Configures discovery and printer URIs, or `null` for discovery only.

**Returns**

The same service collection, for chaining.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `services` is `null`.
- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): A fingerprint in [IppNetworkOptions.TrustedCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#trustedcertificatefingerprints) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't 32 bytes in hexadecimal; a credential has no user name, or one containing a colon; a URI in [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCredentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercredentials) or [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterCertificateFingerprints](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printercertificatefingerprints) isn't an absolute ipp or ipps URI; or [IppNetworkOptions.RequireEncryption](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#requireencryption) is set and [IppNetworkOptions.PrinterUris](/docs/reference/latiprimere-ipp/ippnetworkoptions/#printeruris) has an ipp URI.
